summary: The filing is a Form 8-K by MetaVia Inc. (the issuer) disclosing press releases and poster presentations of new late-breaking data from its obesity and metabolic disease portfolio at the American Diabetes Association's 2026 Scientific Sessions. It includes Phase 1 higher-dose cohort results for DA-1726, a GLP1R/GCGR dual agonist, and preclinical data for vanoglipel (DA-1241) in MASH, T2D, and obesity. The filing is a routine scientific update—no M&A, capital event, or structural change is reported. Items 7.01 (Regulation FD) and 8.01 (Other Events) are used, but the content is purely clinical data dissemination. There are no deal terms or strategic actions. What to watch: whether the Phase 1 data supports advancement to Phase 2 trials.
